dog.description_text:
Karla is a 1-year-old Chihuahua mix who weighs around 15 lbs and is ridiculously adorable. She can be a little shy at first and appreciates having a bit of time to warm up, but once she decides you’re her person, there is apparently no such thing as close enough.

Karla LOVES belly rubs and wants to be pressed against her people at all times. We’re talking full-body contact, snoot practically in your eye, somehow still trying to get even closer. She is incredibly affectionate, very sweet, and the kind of dog who loves her people with her whole tiny body.

Registered adopters interested in Karla can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
